gen-dafont-origami-gf-hedvig-letters-san: Contemporary through and through, Origami draws its lowercase like poured lead. Hedvig Letters Sans sits beneath as a sans with small letters nearly capital height, so the single-stroke brush weight above meets something quieter and more open.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-hind-madurai: Approachable and plain-spoken, Hind Madurai stays out of the way. Origami does the loud work with its single-stroke brush lines and heavy lowercase, while the sans-serif body simply keeps its wide-ended s curves readable.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-khula: Modern and unfussy, Origami brings a brush-drawn ring of an o with constant walls. Khula is plain sans with a tall midsection and curves that keep their mouths open, so it holds up at modest sizes.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-kufam: Kufam draws a single track width, like a neon sign tube. Origami's brush strokes would lose their punch if the heading shrank, since plain sans text beside them already does the quiet work.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca keeps a plain, unshaded line that never swells. Origami's brushed lowercase hits hard up top, while this sans-serif reads smoothly down the column, its terminals stopping short of curling back.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-liter: Liter reads crisp and upright, with no stroke contrast at all. Origami brings the brushed single-stroke heading, and this sans-serif body can stay fairly small because its tall lowercase carries presence.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-mada: Origami paints every line at ruler-straight weight. Mada, the sans-serif body, has curves that refuse to close and a towering midzone, so paragraphs run easy and open down the column.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-martel-sans: Generous curve openings and a high mean line give the body text a light, modern feel. Martel Sans is happy at large sizes, but a shrunken Origami heading loses the thick curves that make it special.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-matangi: Matangi presses its strokes in like twine, leaving rounded letters open and the lowercase hefty. And against Origami's constant-width brush heading, this sans-serif settles into text that feels sturdy rather than fussy.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro reads modern and welcoming, with an open gap in the c and a high-waisted lowercase. Under Origami's brushed heading, its monotone line keeps text smooth and plain.
